name: The Ogres of Feralas
summary: Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache, satisfied that you are a true fighter, sends you on to the High Wilderness, southwest of the camp. Among ruined structures once held by the night elves, Gordunni ogres far tougher than before are to be pushed back. This follows The Ogres of Feralas.

sections.title: Into the High Wilderness
sections.body: Rok Orhan judges that you have proven yourself a true fighter, and trusts you with the next part of the work. The High Wilderness lies southwest of the camp, where abandoned, wrecked structures stand on ground the night elves once owned. Withered trees and desecrated ground show where the Gordunni are. Rok warns that these ogres are far tougher than the earlier ones. Ten Gordunni Shamans, ten Gordunni Warlocks and five Gordunni Maulers are to fall.

faq.q: Who sends you to the High Wilderness?

faq.answer: In the High Wilderness, southwest of Camp Mojache, around wrecked structures on ground the night elves once owned. Withered trees and desecrated ground mark the spot.
Ten Gordunni Shamans, ten Gordunni Warlocks and five Gordunni Maulers.
The first The Ogres of Feralas, in which Rok Orhan sent you against the ogres at their outpost to the north.
